(in-package :depot)
(defvar *naive-steps* 0)
(defun naive-resolve (reg reqs &key (limit 3000000))
  "Chronological backtracking with satisfies-p only. REQS: list of (package . constraint)."
  (setf *naive-steps* 0)
  (labels ((reqs-on (p reqs) (loop for (q . c) in reqs when (string= p q) collect c))
           (ok-release-p (r cs) (and (not (release-yanked-p r))
                                     (every (lambda (c) (satisfies-p (release-version r) c)) cs)))
           (cands (p reqs) (remove-if-not (lambda (r) (ok-release-p r (reqs-on p reqs)))
                                          (package-releases reg p)))
           (search* (order reqs selected)
             (let ((p (find-if-not (lambda (p) (assoc p selected :test #'string=)) order)))
               (if (null p)
                   selected
                   (dolist (r (cands p reqs) nil)
                     (when (> (incf *naive-steps*) limit) (throw 'gave-up :gave-up))
                     (let ((order order) (reqs reqs) (selected (acons p r selected)) (bad nil))
                       (dolist (d (release-dependencies r))
                         (when (eq (dependency-kind d) :runtime)
                           (let ((q (dependency-package d)))
                             (push (cons q (dependency-constraint d)) reqs)
                             (unless (member q order :test #'string=)
                               (setf order (append order (list q))))
                             (let ((s (cdr (assoc q selected :test #'string=))))
                               (when (if s
                                         (not (satisfies-p (release-version s) (dependency-constraint d)))
                                         (null (cands q reqs)))
                                 (setf bad t) (return))))))
                       (unless bad
                         (let ((res (search* order reqs selected)))
                           (when res (return res))))))))))
    (catch 'gave-up
      (let ((order (remove-duplicates (mapcar #'car reqs) :test #'string= :from-end t)))
        (if (some (lambda (p) (null (cands p reqs))) order)
            :failed
            (let ((res (search* order reqs '())))
              (if res
                  (sort (mapcar (lambda (e) (release-name (cdr e))) res) #'string<)
                  :failed)))))))
(defun naive-compare (reg reqs &optional (limit 300000))
  (let ((a (let ((*step-limit* 1000000)) (run reg reqs)))
        (b (naive-resolve reg (mapcar (lambda (r) (cons (requirement-package r) (requirement-constraint r))) reqs)

    (cond ((eq b :gave-up) :gave-up)
          ((equal a b) :same)
          (t (list reqs a b)))))

        (names (coerce (depot.registry::registry-package-names reg) 'vector))
        (diffs '()) (counts '()))

(in-package #:depot)

(defun ref-candidates (registry reqs package)
  (let* ((set (reduce #'version-set-intersection (mapcar #'requirement-versions reqs)
                      :initial-value (any-version)))
         (pre (every (lambda (r) (constraint-allows-prereleases-p (requirement-constraint r))) reqs)))
    (remove-if-not (lambda (release)
                     (let ((v (release-version release)))
                       (and (version-set-contains-p set v)
                            (or pre (not (version-prerelease-p v)))
                            (not (release-yanked-p release)))))
                   (package-releases registry package))))

(defun ref-solve (registry reqs order selected)
  ;; reqs: alist package -> list of reqs (any order); order: list in first-required order
  (let ((next (find-if-not (lambda (p) (assoc p selected :test #'string=)) order)))
    (if (null next)
        selected
        (dolist (release (ref-candidates registry (cdr (assoc next reqs :test #'string=)) next) nil)
          (let ((reqs reqs) (order order) (selected (acons next release selected)) (ok t))
            (dolist (d (release-dependencies release))
              (when (eq (dependency-kind d) :runtime)
                (let* ((p (dependency-package d))
                       (c (dependency-constraint d))
                       (r (make-requirement p c release))
                       (old (cdr (assoc p reqs :test #'string=))))
                  (unless (package-known-p registry p) (setf ok nil) (return))
                  (unless old (setf order (append order (list p))))
                  (setf reqs (acons p (cons r old) reqs))
                  (let ((set (reduce #'version-set-intersection (mapcar #'requirement-versions (cons r old))
                                     :initial-value (any-version)))
                        (chosen (cdr (assoc p selected :test #'string=))))
                    (when (or (version-set-empty-p set)
                              (and chosen (not (satisfies-p (release-version chosen) c))))
                      (setf ok nil) (return))))))
            (when ok
              (let ((result (ref-solve registry reqs order selected)))
                (when result (return result)))))))))

(defun ref-resolve (registry requirements)
  (let ((reqs '()) (order '()))
    (dolist (r requirements)
      (unless (assoc (requirement-package r) reqs :test #'string=)
        (setf order (append order (list (requirement-package r)))))
      (push r (cdr (or (assoc (requirement-package r) reqs :test #'string=)
                       (car (push (list (requirement-package r)) reqs))))))
    (let ((result (ref-solve registry reqs order '())))
      (and result (sort (mapcar #'cdr result) #'string< :key #'release-package)))))

(defun compare-one (registry requirements)
  (let ((ours (handler-case (resolve registry requirements) (resolution-failed () :failed)))
        (ref (or (ref-resolve registry requirements) :failed)))
    (unless (equal (if (listp ours) (mapcar #'release-name ours) ours)
                   (if (listp ref) (mapcar #'release-name ref) ref))
      (list :ours (if (listp ours) (mapcar #'release-name ours) ours)
            :ref (if (listp ref) (mapcar #'release-name ref) ref)))))

(defun compare-all (registry)
  (let ((diffs '()))
    (dolist (name (registry-package-names registry))
      (dolist (c '("*"))
        (let ((d (compare-one registry (list (make-requirement name (parse-constraint c))))))
          (when d (push (cons name d) diffs)))))
    diffs))

(in-package #:depot)

(defvar *ref-steps* 0)

(defun ref-resolve (registry requirements)
  "Plain chronological backtracking, same order as RESOLVE. Returns the
releases or :FAIL."
  (setf *ref-steps* 0)
  (labels ((reqs-on (reqs package)
             (remove package reqs :key #'requirement-package :test-not #'string=))
           (order-of (reqs)
             (remove-duplicates (mapcar #'requirement-package reqs) :test #'string= :from-end t))
           (solve (reqs selected)
             (let ((package (find-if-not (lambda (p) (assoc p selected :test #'string=))
                                         (order-of reqs))))
               (if (null package)
                   (mapcar #'cdr selected)
                   (dolist (release (package-releases registry package) :fail)
                     (when (> (incf *ref-steps*) 2000000) (return-from ref-resolve :limit))
                     (when (and (not (release-yanked-p release))
                                (every (lambda (r) (satisfies-p (release-version release)
                                                                (requirement-constraint r)))
                                       (reqs-on reqs package)))
                       (let* ((new (loop for d in (release-dependencies release)
                                         when (eq (dependency-kind d) :runtime)
                                           collect (make-requirement (dependency-package d)
                                                                     (dependency-constraint d)
                                                                     release)))
                              (selected (acons package release selected)))
                         (when (every (lambda (r)
                                        (let ((chosen (cdr (assoc (requirement-package r) selected
                                                                  :test #'string=))))
                                          (or (null chosen)
                                              (satisfies-p (release-version chosen)
                                                           (requirement-constraint r)))))
                                      new)
                           (let ((result (solve (append reqs new) selected)))
                             (unless (eq result :fail)
                               (return result)))))))))))
    (let ((result (solve requirements '())))
      (if (listp result)
          (sort (copy-list result) #'string< :key #'release-package)
          result))))

(defun compare-with-ref (registry requirements)
  (let ((real (handler-case (resolve registry requirements)
                (resolution-failed (c)
                  (if (resolution-failed-message c) :limit :fail))))
        (ref (ref-resolve registry requirements)))
    (if (or (eq real :limit) (eq ref :limit) (equal (and (listp real) (mapcar #'release-name real))
                                                     (and (listp ref) (mapcar #'release-name ref)))
            (and (eq real :fail) (eq ref :fail)))
        nil
        (list :real (if (listp real) (mapcar #'release-name real) real)
              :ref (if (listp ref) (mapcar #'release-name ref) ref)))))

(defun check-all (registry)
  (let ((bad '()))
    (maphash (lambda (name releases)
               (dolist (release releases)
                 (let ((d (compare-with-ref registry
                                            (list (make-requirement name (parse-constraint
                                                                          (format nil "=~A" (release-version release))))))))
                   (when d (push (cons (release-name release) d) bad)))))
             (registry-packages registry))
    bad))
EOF

(defun chunked (format comp in-chunk out-chunk)
  "Feed COMP to a fresh dstate IN-CHUNK bytes at a time, output OUT-CHUNK at a time."
  (let ((state (make-dstate format)) (out (make-array 0 :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8) :adjustable t :fill-pointer 0))

(defpackage :harness (:use :cl))
(in-package :harness)
(defun slurp (p) (with-open-file (s p :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8))
  (let ((v (make-array (file-length s) :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8)))) (read-sequence v s) v)))
(defun fmt-of (p) (let ((ty (pathname-type p)))
  (cond ((string= ty "gz") 'chipz:gzip) ((string= ty "zlib") 'chipz:zlib) (t 'chipz:deflate))))
(defun orig-of (p) (slurp (format nil "/tmp/chipzbug/~a.bin" (subseq (pathname-name p) 0 (position #\. (pathname-name p))))))

(defun feed (fmt in piece outsize)
  (let ((state (chipz:make-dstate fmt)) (out (make-array outsize :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8)))
        (result (make-array 0 :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8) :adjustable t :fill-pointer 0)))
    (loop for cs from 0 below (max 1 (length in)) by piece
          for ce = (min (length in) (+ cs piece))
          do (loop with s = cs
                   do (multiple-value-bind (c p) (chipz:decompress out state in :input-start s :input-end ce)
                        (incf s c)
                        (loop for i below p do (vector-push-extend (aref out i) result))
                        (when (and (zerop c) (zerop p)) (return))
                        (when (and (>= s ce) (< p outsize)) (return)))))
    (chipz::finish-dstate state)
    (coerce result '(simple-array (unsigned-byte 8) (*)))))

(defun gray (p fmt chunk)
  (with-open-file (in p :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8))
    (let ((gz (chipz:make-decompressing-stream fmt in))
          (result (make-array 0 :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8) :adjustable t :fill-pointer 0)))
      (if (eq chunk :byte)
          (loop for b = (read-byte gz nil nil) while b do (vector-push-extend b result))
          (let ((buf (make-array chunk :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8))))
            (loop for n = (read-sequence buf gz) do (loop for i below n do (vector-push-extend (aref buf i) result))
                  while (= n chunk))))
      (coerce result '(simple-array (unsigned-byte 8) (*))))))

(defun check1 (label thunk orig)
  (handler-case (let ((r (funcall thunk))) (unless (equalp r orig) (list label :mismatch (length r) (length orig))))
    (error (e) (list label (type-of e) (princ-to-string e)))))

(defun run (&key (pieces '(1 2 3 4 5 7 13 255 4096 8191 100000)) (outsizes '(1 7 4096 100000)) (grays '(:byte 1 3 4096 5000 2000000)))
  (let ((fails '()))
    (dolist (p (directory "/tmp/chipzbug/*.*") (nreverse fails))
      (unless (string= (pathname-type p) "bin")
        (let* ((fmt (fmt-of p)) (in (slurp p)) (orig (orig-of p)))
          (flet ((c (label thunk) (let ((f (check1 (list (file-namestring p) label) thunk orig))) (when f (push f fails)))))
            (c :vector (lambda () (chipz:decompress nil fmt in)))
            (c :pathname (lambda () (chipz:decompress nil fmt p)))
            (c :stream (lambda () (with-open-file (s p :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8)) (chipz:decompress nil fmt s))))
            (c :stream-stream (lambda () (with-open-file (s p :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8))
                                           (with-open-file (o "/tmp/chipzbug-scripts/out.tmp" :direction :output :if-exists :supersede :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8))
                                             (chipz:decompress o fmt s)))
                                (slurp "/tmp/chipzbug-scripts/out.tmp")))
            (dolist (g grays) (c (list :gray g) (lambda () (gray p fmt g))))
            (dolist (pc pieces) (dolist (os outsizes)
              (unless (and (= pc 1) (= os 1) (> (length in) 300000))
                (c (list :feed pc os) (lambda () (feed fmt in pc os))))))))))))
EOF

                             (or (null s) (satisfies-p (release-version s) (cdr r))))))
